## Quality checklist

- [ ] Uses the correct template
- [ ] Has aliases where useful
- [ ] Has tags
- [ ] Has related terms
- [ ] Has a real-world example
- [ ] Has common mistakes or misconceptions where useful
- [ ] Has production notes
- [ ] Has source notes where needed
- [ ] Clearly separates discovery sources from canonical sources

## Source rule

- [ ] Newsletters/blogs are used only for vocabulary discovery unless no stronger source exists
- [ ] Official docs / papers / standards are used for final definitions where possible
- [ ] Any uncertainty is marked clearly

## Privacy / redaction

- [ ] No private credentials, secrets, or personal sensitive details
- [ ] Conversation captures have been redacted before publication
